stories.title: ‘Inexplicable’ High-Speed Train Crash Leaves Dozens Dead
stories.summary: Two high-speed trains collided south of Madrid on Wednesday morning, killing at least 68 people and injuring more than 100, according to Al Jazeera; other early reports gave lower casualty figures. The crash occurred on the high-speed line linking Madrid with Andalusia and was described by the BBC as Spain’s worst rail disaster since 2013. Spain’s transport minister blamed a failed control system, according to the Daily Wire excerpt.

stories.title: Silicon Valley parents want the tech they help build out of their children’s schools
stories.summary: Parents working in Silicon Valley’s technology industry are increasingly seeking schools that limit classroom technology for their own children. Both private and public schools in tech-heavy regions are reducing screen use, according to The Guardian. The trend also raises whether lower-income school districts can afford to follow the same approach.
